en.accountAutoSwitchHint: When a quota runs out or a key is unusable, the other accounts are tried in order; the account that starts producing output moves to the first position and becomes current.
en.accountConfigureHint: Add a key to read usage
en.accountFallbackCredential: The current key was unavailable or rejected; switched to
en.accountFallbackQuota: The current account reached its quota; switched to
en.accountKeyHint: The key is saved through the host credential service and is never returned to this page.
en.accountRemoveHint: Remove “{name}”? If it is the current account, the next account takes over. Keys added here are deleted from the credential service; existing external references are kept.
en.accountsBlocked: Save or discard the API key draft before changing accounts.
en.accountsCleanupFailed: The account entry was removed, but its stored key could not be deleted. Remove the unused reference through the host credential service.
en.accountsEmpty: Add an account to use OpenCode Go.
en.accountsReadFailed: Could not read account status. Please refresh.
en.accountsRemoveKeyFailed: The stored key could not be deleted, so the account was kept. Please retry.
en.accountSwitchFailed: Could not switch account. Please retry.
en.accountSwitchHint: This account moves to the first position and serves later requests in this profile. The other accounts keep their relative order.
en.accountsWriteFailed: Could not apply the account change. Your input is kept; please retry.
en.advancedHint: The inherited values work as they are; below are only the settings you may need to change.
en.baseURLHint: The endpoint that serves model requests and the live model listing.
en.capacityMissing: API did not provide a value
en.configurationMissingHint: The gateway lists this model, but no usable OpenCode Go configuration is available. Once the upstream configuration is supplied or corrected, refresh the list to enable it.
en.configurationUnavailableHint: The model configuration could not be loaded, and no usable cached or built-in configuration is available for this model. Check network access to models.dev from the machine running DSH and the error details above, then refresh.
en.deprecatedHint: Marked deprecated by models.dev, but still provided by this gateway.
en.enabledHint: While on, it appears in every model picker and can serve requests; turning it off withdraws it immediately and this page stays reachable.
en.enabledOff: OpenCode Go is off: its models are withdrawn from every picker and no request reaches the gateway.
en.enabledUnavailable: This deployment pins the switch on in its composition, so it cannot be changed here.
en.intro: Choose the OpenCode Go models shown in conversations and adjust their capacities.
en.keyHint: From your OpenCode Go subscription (opencode.ai). Leaving this blank keeps the key already saved, and a saved key applies to the next request without a restart.
en.keyNotWritable: This key is supplied from outside the settings document (an environment variable, for example), so it cannot be changed here.
en.limitsEmpty: Read the model list first; capacities are edited per model the gateway serves.
en.limitsFilterPlaceholder: Search by model name or id…
en.limitsHint: Capacities come from the online configuration; blank keeps the default and Save applies your overrides.
en.limitsNoMatches: No models match “{query}”. Try a different name or id.
en.maxImagesHint: Leave empty to inherit the base configuration (uncapped only when the base sets none); above the cap the oldest images become text placeholders.
en.maxRequestImageBytesHint: The cap on the accumulated base64 image payload in one request.
en.modalitiesForwarding: This plugin converts and forwards image attachments only.
en.modalitiesSource: Input modalities come from the online models.dev configuration.
en.modelsEmpty: The gateway currently serves no model this adapter can route.
en.modelsFailed: Could not read the gateway model list.
en.modelsMetadataFailed: Could not load model configuration from models.dev. Models with usable cached or built-in configuration remain available. See the error details below, check network access from the machine running DSH, then refresh.
en.modelsRefreshing: Refreshing… Keeping the last fetched models visible.
en.modelsStale: Some model data could not be refreshed. Available cached or built-in data is still in use, including in conversation pickers.
en.newHint: Released within the last seven UTC calendar days, according to models.dev.
en.pickerFailed: Could not update model visibility. Please retry.
en.protocolOverridesHint: Auto follows the model catalog; Responses is experimental and applies only to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Save to apply to new requests.
en.proxyURLHint: The HTTP(S) or SOCKS5 proxy for conversations, catalog refreshes and usage queries; leave empty for the default network.
en.proxyURLInvalid: Enter an http://, https:// or socks5:// proxy address without a path, query or fragment.
en.readOnly: The settings document is read-only in this deployment.
en.refreshMinutesHint: How long the model catalog is cached; opening this page or refreshing re-checks it immediately.
en.requestImageMaxBytesHint: The original byte target of one image before base64 expansion.
en.requestImagePixelBudgetHint: The total pixel budget of one image after conversion.
en.savedFailed: The last save did not land as staged; correct the values or discard.
en.starProject: Enjoying the plugin? Star it on GitHub
en.starProjectTitle: Open the GitHub project in a new tab
en.streamIdleTimeoutMsHint: The longest silence between stream events; a longer gap fails the request.
en.thinkingBudgetsHint: Add token budgets to the conversation picker, then Save. Range: {min}–{max} tokens. Existing reasoning choices stay available; Default uses the service settings. The SDK may reduce a budget to leave room for the answer.
en.title: OpenCode Go
en.unavailable: The OpenCode Go settings are not served in this deployment.
en.usageDisplayHint: Auto shows it only for DSH OpenCode Go models; Always keeps it visible with any model; Off hides it and stops polling. While visible it refreshes every minute.
en.usageStaleHint: Showing the last successful usage reading. Current usage may have changed.
en.visibilityHint: Only enabled models appear in conversation pickers. Changes apply immediately. Deprecated models are off by default and can be enabled individually.
